commands_used: answer 1. I am hunting the Unbound/Seal trail for the order. A wounded Unbound scout, Tah-Leesh, told me to ask what moans in the cellar of Fort Chalkmoth, an Archwarden fort. Never-Writes-Twice dismissed it. This is my own side errand; the main hunt is at Bell Station. 2. Get into the fort keep and see its cellar, starting here at Fort Chalkmoth. 3. Ask the wall captain Sakeeus-Wan for leave to enter, or find another way in unseen; there is a locked keep door and a guardroom door. 4. I do not know who the Sarpa Raiders here are or what moans in the cellar. I could find out by talking to Sakeeus-Wan and looking around.

answer 1. The wall captain will open the keep only if I kill three Sarpa raiders robbing chalk carts on the western approach, and pay 100 gold. I want to see the cellar for the Unbound scout hint. 2. Kill the three raiders on the western approach, then report to Sakeeus-Wan. 3. Fight the raiders for the captain, or sneak in by the trapdoor in the yard. 4. Nothing major; I do not know what is in the cellar yet.

answer 1. I cleared the raiders and got the keep key and 100 gold. The cellar stair is in the quartermaster Theyne Indarys store, and the captain warns that entering the store is theft. 2. Go into the keep, reach the store, look at the sap jars, speak to gaoler Tsleel-Vaku at the stair foot, try the cellar door. 3. Pick the store lock, lift the quartermaster key, or perhaps ask him. 4. I do not know what Jal-Veesa Knot sap jars mean, or what moans below; I will look and ask.
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Keep
pick Door to Quartermaster's Store win
use Door to Fort Chalkmoth Guardroom
pick Door to Cellar Door win

answer 1. The order stores Hist sap jars tied with Jal-Veesa knot by a cellar stair in a fort with no Hist; something moans behind a door the gaoler guards and Never-Writes-Twice holds the key to. She dismissed the fort to me, which is suspicious. 2. Go back to the hunt: Bell Station, east of Lilmoth by boat, to ask the divers which drowned tower is marked. 3. Go to Bell Station now; or confront Never-Writes-Twice in Helstrom about the cellar and key. 4. I do not know who or what is in the cellar or why the order feeds it sap. I might learn it from Never-Writes-Twice or Jal-Veesa at Noota Nara.

answer Notes: Fort Chalkmoth done as far as I can take it. I killed three Sarpa raiders for wall captain Sakeeus-Wan and got the keep key and 100 gold. I picked the quartermaster Theyne Indarys store lock and saw sealed Hist sap jars tied with Jal-Veesa knot (tree-minder at Noota Nara) by the cellar stair; the fort has no Hist of its own. Theyne says they arrive every season and he asks nothing. Gaoler Tsleel-Vaku guards the cellar door, refused persuasion and illusion, and says Never-Writes-Twice keeps the key; I cannot pick the door. Something moans behind it; who or why unknown, and Never-Writes-Twice hid this from me. I carry about 1250 gold, Unbound recipe and note, lockpicks x2, paralysis poison x3, rapier, keep key. Next: Bell Station by boat from Lilmoth to learn which drowned tower in Benthic Yobesh is marked; Vanin the Collector is digging ahead. Option: press Never-Writes-Twice or Jal-Veesa about the cellar.
